title: Greek Pasta Salad with Feta, Olives and Peppers
summary: A small, bright Greek-style pasta salad with salty feta, olives, sweet peppers and a lemony herb dressing. It’s fresh enough for dinner and tastes even better after a short chill.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta until just tender. Drain well and rinse briefly under cold water to cool it down.
While the pasta cooks, dice the red pepper and cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, thinly slice the red onion, and chop the parsley.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and black pepper in a large bowl.
Add the cooled pasta, vegetables and olives to the bowl and toss until everything is evenly coated.
Crumble the feta over the top, add the parsley, and toss very gently so the cheese stays in pieces.
Taste and adjust with a little more salt, pepper or lemon juice if needed. Serve right away or chill for 10 minutes for a colder salad.
